description.value:
Requirements You have a free hand and are within reach of your own Vitae.

You open yourself -- or whoever's on the table -- and cut a Graft you know into shape on the spot, paying its Craft Cost out of your Vitae pool; skip a proper working table and you risk a Bloom. This action only draws 1 Vitae on its own, so for any Graft whose Craft Cost reads higher than that, you deduct the rest from your pool by hand.
